author: The Spiffing Brit
description:
3 Youtubers Vs The end of the world as we know it. Welcome to John Carpenter's Toxic Commando, a brand new release from Saber interactive and Focus Entertainment. Its a squad based zombie FPS similar in style to sabers other games like World War Z and Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2. Throw in inspiration from valves incredible left 4 dead series and somehow the game snowrunner and you end up with John Carpenter's Toxic Commando.

This stream is SPONSORED (I am being paid to play the game for 2 hours)! If you like what you see in the game and want to try it out for yourself you can follow this lovely link:  https://bit.ly/3NhyQX6

A Huge thanks to the wonderful @Sips and @Ravs_ I hope you have fun watching A Brit, A Scot And A Canadian Walk Into the  Apocalypse and hopefully survive!
